fields.summary_ko.0: CrowdStrike (CRWD) rose 8.2% on October 23 as Evercore ISI channel partner survey showed improved budget outlook for cybersecurity vendors; anticipated security breaches from PHP vulnerability supported stock price.
fields.summary_ko.1: CrowdStrike stock price gained +106% over past 12 months, significantly outpacing S&P 500's +15.1%; trading at 48.7x revenue multiple relative to S&P 500 indicates overvaluation.
